native_configuration.note: Previously recovered original X2D II factory plist, parsed by native CXMLLut; no generated matrices or LUTs are injected into correction objects.

shadow_weight_probe.operation: ColorNormalCorrectPixels applies CalculateGrayWeight to the mapped chroma terms; Y is retained as the reconstruction baseline before the film curve.

scope.compared: Original non-HDR X2D II native color core, original CGradationFilter, and virtual-whitepoint/preset gain semantics versus the recorded C++ source.
not_covered: Full native RAW demosaic, lens, spatial sharpening, or HDR chain equivalence.
Physical iPhone-to-Hasselblad sensor calibration or all-scene color accuracy.
The native-input APIs tested here take already normalized and white-balanced native RGB; no Apple RAW pixels are used.
